scope: 3240 matched primary cells across three models and three tasks
behavior_source: anonymous actions, observations, batches, timeline, and public task only
primary_tests: frozen paired bootstrap and sign randomization; Holm over S1-S4 versus S0 within each task/model
exploratory_family: 27 S1-S3 contrasts over all three models/tasks; S4 contrasts separate
semantic_adherence: lexical and action measures only; no automatic semantic labels claimed
effort: search/open actions; provider tokens joined separately; no elapsed-time analysis
exploratory_goal_control_family: 27 S1-S3 versus S4 contrasts; Holm across models and tasks
exploratory_model_skill_family: 27 differences in S1-S3 gains between model pairs; Holm across pairs and tasks
